title: Build modern AI development tools
body: Our platform combines cutting-edge AI models with intuitive interfaces to streamline your development workflow and boost productivity.

slide1.title: Collaborative documentation
slide1.body: With version history, inline comments, and real-time editing.

slide2.title: Multiple AI models
slide2.body: Including GPT-5, Claude, and Llama with seamless switching between providers and unified API access for all your AI needs.

slide3.title: Automated workflows
slide3.body: With drag-and-drop pipeline builder and pre-built integrations.

slide4.title: Global infrastructure
slide4.body: Deploy across multiple regions with automatic failover, low latency connections, and intelligent traffic routing.

slide5.title: Intelligent code completion
slide5.body: Understands your codebase and suggests context-aware snippets.

slide6.title: Visual flow builder
slide6.body: Create complex data pipelines with an intuitive visual interface, drag-and-drop nodes, and real-time preview of your workflow execution.
